notes.title: BRIGHT DAYS IN QUARANTINE - Update V 0.2
notes.content:
As we are listening to you there in the Community Hub, we have updated Bright Days in Quarantine with an original new song produced especially for the Gameplay.

Besides, we have fixed some bugs of the previous version.

We want to give our players the best experience, so we will always be creating new themes and updating the game with improvements and new features.

Continue participating in our Community Hub and giving your suggestions for new themes and improvements for BRIGHT DAYS IN QUARANTINE!

notes.title: BRIGHT DAYS IN QUARANTINE - Update V 0.1
notes.content:
As a way to celebrate our community, everyone who plays Bright Days in Quarantine will now have the chance to get 10 unique Achievements. 

Besides, as we are listening to you there in the Community Hub, we have also included some of your suggestions for improvements and fixed some problems of the previous version.

We want to give our players the best experience, so we will always be creating new themes and updating the game with improvements and new features.

Continue participating in our Community Hub and giving your suggestions for new themes and improvements for BRIGHT DAYS IN QUARANTINE!
